channel.title: EdSharp Walkthroughs
channel.description: Spoken walks through EdSharp, the text and code editor for working by ear. Ten walks, each under five minutes, in the order a new person meets them.
channel.itunes:author: Jamal Mazrui

item.title: 0 - Overview
item.description: Nothing is needed; this walk is listened to. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0-0-overview

item.title: 1 - User Interface
item.description: EdSharp is open, with an empty document. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0a-1-user-interface

item.title: 2 - Install and Launch
item.description: The installer is downloaded, and your reader is running. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0b-2-install-and-launch

item.title: 3 - Open, Edit and Save a File
item.description: EdSharp is open, and letter.txt is in your Documents folder. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0c-3-open-edit-and-save-a-file

item.title: 4 - Find Your Way in a Long Document
item.description: A long document is open in EdSharp. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0d-4-find-your-way-in-a-long-document

item.title: 5 - Convert Between Formats
item.description: EdSharp is open, and report.docx is in your Documents folder. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0e-5-convert-between-formats

item.title: 6 - Write Code
item.description: EdSharp is open on a short Python file with one mistake, and Python was ticked when EdSharp was installed. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0f-6-write-code

item.title: 7 - Ask the AI on Your Own Computer
item.description: EdSharp is open on a document, and Ollama with a model was ticked when EdSharp was installed, or installed since. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0g-7-ask-the-ai-on-your-own-computer

item.title: 8 - Do Math
item.description: EdSharp is open with a new document. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0h-8-do-math

item.description: Nothing is needed. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0i-9-conclusion
